title: Give each screen a waiting list it can rearrange

cases.says: waiting() lists everyone still waiting in arrival order, and next(n) the first n of them, or all if fewer wait
sorting and removing names from the list waiting() returned leaves the waitlist's own order and size unchanged
a list next(n) returned still holds the same patients, and can still be read, after others check in or are called in
a list next(n) returned can be added to even when it is empty, and adding to it does not touch the waitlist

origin.section: A Returned Collection Is Whatever the Caller Can Do With It
